title: It’s Rayquaza Season: The Amazing Chase Is Back
body_markdown:
*TL;DR: A new*[Pokémon pack](https://courtyard.io/vending-machine?category=pkmn) *drops every day for five days. Every pack hides two Rayquaza bounty cards, and pulling one earns you the card plus bonus Courtyard Points.*


[Delta Reign](https://tcg.pokemon.com/en-us/expansions/delta-reign/) just put Mega Rayquaza back on top of the Pokémon world, so we’re making it the face of the chase.


The Amazing Chase is our favorite way to drop packs, and you made Round 2 the biggest event we’ve ever run. Round 3 keeps everything you loved: a new pack every day, a price ladder that climbs to a finale, and hidden bounties waiting to be found.


The twist this time: every bounty is a Rayquaza. Fourteen of them, from modern VMAXs to vintage holos, spread across seven packs. And alongside them, each pack is loaded with heavy hitters from across the Pokédex.


## How the Bounties Work


The chase starts with a $19 Pokémon pack, with a new pack dropping each day through the $99 finale and 14 bounty cards hidden across all five drops.


Each pack has two bounty cards, and you can see them on the pack page before you rip. Pull one and the card is yours, plus bonus Courtyard Points that grow with the pack: 8,000 points on Day 1, up to 40,000 on the Day 5 finale.


All the daily packs stay live through the end of the event, so the chase only gets bigger as the week goes on. A pack stays up until it sells out or both of its bounties are pulled.


**Important note:** To receive bounty points, you must keep the bounty card in your Courtyard collection until the end of the Amazing Chase event. Selling or transferring the card before then means disqualification.


## [Day 1: Sky High - $19](https://courtyard.io/vending-machine?category=limited_drop)


The chase starts where Rayquaza’s modern run took off. Hunt a Silver Tempest Rayquaza VMAX and a Spirit Link Rayquaza, both PSA 10.


## [Day 2: Cracked Ice - $39](https://courtyard.io/vending-machine?category=limited_drop)


Day 2 brings the shine. The bounties are a Cracked Ice Skytree Town Rayquaza and an Evolving Skies Rayquaza V, both PSA 9.


## [Day 3: Roaring Skies - $59](https://courtyard.io/vending-machine?category=limited_drop)


Mega Rayquaza is back in Delta Reign, so we’re bringing back the original. Chase a Roaring Skies M Rayquaza EX and a CGC 10 Skytree Town Rayquaza.


## [Day 4: Going Gold - $79](https://courtyard.io/vending-machine?category=limited_drop)


The stakes climb as the vintage comes out. Day 4’s bounties are a Supreme Victors Rayquaza C and a Japanese Gold Rayquaza, each valued around $1,200.


## [Day 5: The Final Stop - $99](https://courtyard.io/vending-machine?category=limited_drop)


The finale is where the biggest targets live. Hunt a PSA 10 Beat of the Frontier Rayquaza C, valued around $2,400, and an EX Emerald Rayquaza Holo.


## The Chase Keeps Growing


The Amazing Chase started as an experiment, and you turned it into our biggest event. Round 3 brings seven packs, 14 Rayquaza bounties and a new reason to check in every day.


Rayquaza season starts now.[Rip Day 1](https://courtyard.io/vending-machine?category=limited_drop) and see you on the chase.
